name: Resentment
descEn: Increases attack when you have recoverable damage (the red portion of your Health Gauge).

name: Adrenaline Rush
descEn: Temporarily increases attack power after executing a perfectly-timed evade just as a monster attacks.

name: Peak Performance
descEn: Increases attack when your health is full.

name: Counterstrike
descEn: Temporarily increases attack power after being knocked back.

name: Weakness Exploit
descEn: Increases the affinity of attacks that exploit a monster's weak  points and wounds.

name: Maximum Might
descEn: Increases affinity if stamina is kept full for a period of time.

name: Convert Element
descEn: After taking elemental damage, temporarily grants you dragon element effects. (Cooldown after effect ends.)

name: Defense Boost
descEn: Increases defense. Also improves resistances at higher levels.

name: Divine Blessing
descEn: Has a predetermined chance of reducing the damage you take.

name: Fire Resistance
descEn: Increases fire resistance. Also improves defense at higher levels.

name: Water Resistance
descEn: Increases water resistance. Also improves defense at higher levels.

name: Thunder Resistance
descEn: Increases thunder resistance. Also improves defense at higher levels.

name: Ice Resistance
descEn: Increases ice resistance. Also improves defense at higher levels.

name: Dragon Resistance
descEn: Increases dragon resistance. Also improves defense at higher levels.

name: Poison Resistance
descEn: Reduces damage while poisoned.

name: Paralysis Resistance
descEn: Reduces the duration of paralysis.

name: Sleep Resistance
descEn: Reduces the duration of sleep.

name: Iron Skin
descEn: Grants protection against defense down.

name: Blight Resistance
descEn: Grants protection against all elemental blights.

name: Stun Resistance
descEn: Reduces the duration of stun.

name: Bleeding Resistance
descEn: Grants protection against bleeding.

name: Bind Resistance
descEn: Grants protection against webbed status and frostblight.

name: Blast Resistance
descEn: Grants protection against blastblight.

name: Stench Resistance
descEn: Grants protection against stench.

name: Adaptability
descEn: Grants protection against environmental damage, such as from heat or cold.

name: Recovery Up
descEn: Increases the amount recovered when restoring health.

name: Recovery Speed
descEn: Speeds healing of recoverable damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).

name: Survival Expert
descEn: Extra health is recovered from environmental interactables.

name: Constitution
descEn: Reduces stamina depletion when evading, blocking, or doing certain other actions.

name: Stamina Surge
descEn: Speeds up stamina recovery.

name: Marathon Runner
descEn: Slows down stamina depletion for actions that continuously drain stamina (such as dashing).

name: Hunger Resistance
descEn: Reduces maximum stamina depletion over time.

name: Agitator
descEn: Increases attack power and affinity when large monsters become enraged.

name: Latent Power
descEn: Temporarily increases affinity and reduces stamina depletion when certain conditions are met.

name: Heroics
descEn: Increases attack power and defense when health drops to 35% or lower.

name: Burst
descEn: Continuously landing hits gradually increases attack and elemental attack. (Amount increased depends on weapon.)

name: Foray
descEn: Increases attack power and affinity against large monsters affected by poison or paralysis.

name: Flayer
descEn: Makes it easier to inflict wounds. Can also deal extra non-elemental damage upon buildup. (Excludes some attacks.)

name: Palico Rally
descEn: Powers up Palicoes.

name: Partbreaker
descEn: Makes it easier to break large monster parts, and increases damage dealt when destroying a wound with a Focus Strike.

name: Coalescence
descEn: Temporarily increases elemental attack power and status effects after recovering from blights or abnormal status.

name: Ambush
descEn: Temporarily increases damage to large monsters with a successful Sneak Attack.

name: Antivirus
descEn: Once infected, makes it easier to overcome the Frenzy and increases affinity if cured.

name: Elemental Absorption
descEn: After taking elemental damage, temporarily grants you element effects. (Cooldown after effect ends)

name: Self-Improvement
descEn: Attack and defense increase as time passes while on a quest. (The maximum is reached after 30 minutes.)

name: Evade Window
descEn: Extends the invulnerability period when evading.

name: Evade Extender
descEn: Increases evade distance.

name: Earplugs
descEn: Grants protection from large monsters' roars.

name: Quick Sheathe
descEn: Speeds up weapon sheathing.

name: Windproof
descEn: Grants protection against wind pressure.

name: Tremor Resistance
descEn: Grants protection against ground tremors.

name: Flinch Free
descEn: Prevents knockbacks and other reactions to small damage.

name: Intimidator
descEn: Reduces the chance small monsters will attack after spotting you. (Has no effect on certain monsters.)

name: Speed Eating
descEn: Increases meat-eating and item-consumption speed.

name: Aquatic/Oilsilt Mobility
descEn: Grants resistance against impairments to mobility while in water, oilsilt, or streams.

name: Shock Absorber
descEn: Disables damage reactions when you hit a friend or when a friend hits you.

name: Leap of Faith
descEn: Allows you to do a dive-evade when facing towards large monsters and extends the dive-evade distance.

name: Jump Master
descEn: Prevents attacks from knocking you back during a jump.

name: Cliffhanger
descEn: Decreases stamina depletion when climbing on vines.

name: Wide-Range
descEn: Allows the effects of certain items to also affect nearby allies.

name: Tool Specialist
descEn: Reduces the recharge time for specialized tools.

name: Bombardier
descEn: Increases the damage of explosive items.

name: Mushroomancer
descEn: Lets you digest mushrooms that would otherwise be inedible and gain their advantageous effects.

name: Item Prolonger
descEn: Extends the duration of some item effects.

name: Free Meal
descEn: Gives you a predetermined chance of consuming a food or drink item for free.

name: Blindsider
descEn: Improves the effectiveness of flash attacks and items.

name: Botanist
descEn: Increases the quantity of herbs and other consumable items you gather.

name: Geologist
descEn: Increases the number of items you gain at gathering points.

name: Entomologist
descEn: The bodies of small insect monsters won't be destroyed, allowing them to be carved. (Excludes some.)

name: Outdoorsman
descEn: Improves fishing, grilling, and transporting abilities.

name: Rice Ball
descEn: Increases the attack power of Akuma actions and stun damage.

name: Attack Boost
descEn: Increases attack power.

name: Offensive Guard
descEn: Temporarily increases attack power after executing a perfectly-timed guard.

name: Critical Eye
descEn: Increases affinity.

name: Critical Boost
descEn: Increases the damage of critical hits.

name: Critical Draw
descEn: Increases affinity when performing draw attacks. (Not effective while riding.)

name: Fire Attack
descEn: Increases fire element attack power. (Elemental attack power has a maximum limit.)

name: Water Attack
descEn: Increases water element attack power. (Elemental attack power has a maximum limit.)

name: Ice Attack
descEn: Increases ice element attack power. (Elemental attack power has a maximum limit.)

name: Thunder Attack
descEn: Increases thunder element attack power. (Elemental attack power has a maximum limit.)

name: Dragon Attack
descEn: Increases dragon element attack power. (Elemental attack power has a maximum limit.)

name: Poison Attack
descEn: Increases the rate of poison buildup. (Poison buildup has a maximum limit.)

name: Paralysis Attack
descEn: Increases the rate of paralysis buildup. (Paralysis buildup has a maximum limit.)

name: Sleep Attack
descEn: Increases the rate of sleep buildup. (Sleep buildup has a maximum limit.)

name: Blast Attack
descEn: Increases the rate of blast buildup. (Blast buildup has a maximum limit.)

name: Critical Element
descEn: Increases elemental damage (fire, water, thunder, ice, dragon) when landing critical hits.

name: Critical Status
descEn: Increases abnormal status effects (paralysis, poison, sleep, blast) when landing critical hits.

name: Charge Master
descEn: Increases element power and status buildup for charged attacks.

name: Handicraft
descEn: Extends the weapon sharpness gauge. However, it will not increase the gauge past its maximum.

name: Razor Sharp
descEn: Prevents your weapon from losing sharpness.

name: Protective Polish
descEn: Weapon sharpness does not decrease for a set time after sharpening.

name: Mind's Eye
descEn: Your attacks are deflected less and are more powerful against hard monster parts.

name: Bludgeoner
descEn: Increases damage dealt when your weapon sharpness is low.

name: Master's Touch
descEn: Prevents your weapon from losing sharpness during critical hits.

name: Normal Shots
descEn: Increases the attack power of Normal Ammo, normal arrows, and Flying Swallow Shot.

name: Piercing Shots
descEn: Increases the attack of the bowgun's Pierce Ammo, and the bow's Dragon Piercer and Thousand Dragons.

name: Spread/Power Shots
descEn: Increases the attack of the bowgun's Spread Ammo and the bow's Power Shots and Quick Shots.

name: Ballistics
descEn: Extends the range in which ammo and arrows have maximum power. Also boosts power at higher levels.

name: Rapid Fire Up
descEn: Improves light bowgun rapid fire.

name: Opening Shot
descEn: Increases the bowgun's reload speed and increases the power of bullets when fully loaded.

name: Tetrad Shot
descEn: Increases affinity of bowgun ammo/ coatings from the fourth shot and attack of the fourth and sixth shots.

name: Special Ammo Boost
descEn: Increases the power of the bowgun's special ammo, and the bow's Dragon Piercer, Thousand Dragons, and Tracer.

name: Poison Functionality
descEn: Allows you to apply poison coatings.

name: Para Functionality
descEn: Allows you to apply paralysis coatings.

name: Sleep Functionality
descEn: Allows you to apply sleep coatings.

name: Blast Functionality
descEn: Allows you to apply blast coatings.

name: Exhaust Functionality
descEn: Allows you to apply exhaust coatings.

name: Focus
descEn: Increases the fill rate for weapons with gauges and the charge rate for weapons with charge attacks.

name: Power Prolonger
descEn: Allows long swords, dual blades, insect glaives, switch axes, and charge blades to stay powered up longer.

name: Punishing Draw
descEn: Adds a stun effect to draw attacks and slightly increases attack power. (Not effective while riding.)

name: Slugger
descEn: Makes it easier to stun monsters.

name: Stamina Thief
descEn: Increases certain attacks' ability to exhaust monsters.

name: Artillery
descEn: Strengthens explosive attacks like shells, Wyvern's Fire, charge blade phial attacks, and Sticky Ammo.

name: Rapid Morph
descEn: Increases switch speed and power for switch axes and charge blades.

name: Horn Maestro
descEn: Increases the effect duration of hunting horn melodies. (Effect lost when you change weapons.)

name: Charge Up
descEn: Increases the damage and stun power of charged hammer attacks.

name: Airborne
descEn: Increases the damage caused by jumping attacks.

name: Poison Duration Up
descEn: Extends the duration of your poison's effect on monsters.

name: Guard
descEn: Reduces knockbacks and stamina depletion when guarding.

name: Guard Up
descEn: Reduces damage taken when guarding and allows you to guard against ordinarily unblockable attacks.

name: Load Shells
descEn: Improves reloading, and increases the gunlance's shell capacity and charge blade's phial capacity.

name: Speed Sharpening
descEn: Speeds up weapon sharpening when using a whetstone.

name: Slicked Blade
descEn: Temporarily increases affinity when wet or when inflicted with bubbleblight. (Wet and bubbleblight effects stack.)

name: Whiteflame Torrent
descEn: Chance to deal additional damage after landing an attack.

name: Convert Thunder Resistance
descEn: Increase to your weapon's elemental attack proportional to your thunder resistance.

name: Bladescale Honing
descEn: Narrowly evading a monster's attack while your weapon is drawn grants special sharpness.

name: Bladescale Loading
descEn: Narrowly evading a monster's attack while your weapon is drawn grants special loaded ammo or applied coatings.

name: Power Stone
descEn: Temporarily increases attack upon mining materials.

name: Crackling Cornpopper
descEn: Increases shelling power and fire attack while the Wyvern's Fire Gauge is blinking red.

name: Grillmaster
descEn: Grill meat to sharpen your weapon and temporarily increase your attack. (Duration and effect vary based on results.)

name: Evading Reload
descEn: Evading loads the currently selected ammo automatically.

name: Darkside
descEn: Performing certain Lvl 2 or higher charged slashes deals self-damage. Attack is also temporarily boosted.

name: Synthetic Shield
descEn: Temporarily increases your defense and the defense of those around you after a successful Perfect Guard.

name: Synergy
descEn: Temporarily increases your affinity and the affinity of those around you after using a Rising Spiral Slash.
